name: Basic roles and permissions
summary: Owner, admin, member, viewer. Every capability that has protected surfaces declares its permissions here. Superseded by access.rebac when that upgrade is selected; the can() interface survives the substitution unchanged, which is why no consumer has to be rewritten.

requires.reason: A role is an assignment to a user.

consumes.name: identity.user.created
consumes.reason: assign the default role to a newly created user

exposes.name: can
exposes.signature: can(user: User, action: string, resource?: ResourceRef): Promise<boolean>
exposes.description: The permission check every capability calls. access.rebac must satisfy this exact signature to upgrade this capability.

exposes.name: permissions
exposes.description: Permission declarations contributed by every capability with protected surfaces.

slots.name: roleDefinitions
slots.when: at boot, when the role set is resolved
slots.description: Client-specific roles beyond owner, admin, member, viewer.

slots.name: permissionResolver
slots.when: on every can() call not satisfied by a declared role

smoke.name: default role on registration
smoke.asserts: a newly created user receives the configured default role

smoke.name: guard denies without permission
smoke.asserts: a protected route returns 403 for a user lacking the declared permission

templates.description: The permission set collected from every capability's registers block in the resolved graph.
